cell.description: Cell or profile name, empty when unscoped.

cleanup.description: Cleanup track; verdicts never wait on it.

commit.description: Exact commit the run validates (or names, when refused).

exit_code.description: Component exit code once terminal, when recorded.

host_limits_path.description: Host-limits file consulted for admission, when recorded.

outcome.description: Ledger outcome spelling once terminal, when recorded.

run_id.description: Run identity, unique per admitted run.

started_at.description: Start time as an ISO-8601 timestamp, when recorded.

CleanupState.description: Cleanup track of one run, orthogonal to the verdict state.

oneOf.description: Deletion has not been attempted or is not owed.
Deletion was attempted and is incomplete; journaled debt.
The checkout is deleted (or never existed).

RunState.description:
Verdict lifecycle of one run, in wire spelling.

`Finished`, `Stopped` and `Stale` are the pre-lifecycle spellings
the Python prototype already writes; new writers use the
lifecycle states and must not invent further spellings.

oneOf.description: Evidence is being extracted from the checkout.
The terminal record is being written; terminal at write.
Terminal: tests failed or a CPU-budget breach timed out.
Terminal: no result was produced; never evidence of green.
Terminal at admission: refused, no checkout, no failure row.
